description: Adapt a pattern to a brand system. Pass a pattern slug/number and a brand (colors, typography, spacing, radius) and get back the pattern's HTML/CSS/JS with every visual token replaced by the brand's values. The pattern's behavior, motion, and structure are preserved — only its visual expression changes. This is how a client gets THEIR pattern, not a generic one. FREE, no key required.

brand.description: the brand system to adapt to

slug.description: pattern slug or number to adapt

name: adapt_pattern
